title: Fixed-degree coproduct comparison for derived direct image
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $(E_i)_{i\in I}$ be any set-indexed family in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $S\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ with coprojections $\iota_i:E_i\to S$ satisfying the ambient coproduct universal property. For each fixed integer $q$, the morphism of module sheaves $\bigoplus_i H^q(Rf_*E_i)\to H^q(Rf_*S)$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] induced by the $H^q(Rf_*\iota_i)$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 08DZ, proof: cohomology comparison, with Tag 08D5(2)

proof.text: Use [lem-pc-derived-ambient-direct-sums] to identify the cohomology of the given ambient coproduct with the direct sum of the quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves of its summands. Express this sum as the directed colimit of finite sums: [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-direct-sum] and [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-colimit-affine-sections] give quasi-coherence, including the empty sum.

Check the comparison locally over an affine open V of Y. Exact restriction preserves sums; [lem-sc-derived-k-injective-restrict-open] identifies restricted derived direct image with direct image along the restriction of f. Choose the uniform upper cohomological bound from [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-uniform-truncation-bound] over V, and use the truncation triangle to replace each summand and its sum by the same lower truncation without changing degree-q direct-image cohomology. Exact sums commute with these canonical truncations. This uses the uniform upper-bound clause, not an interchange of the quantifiers in its separate objectwise truncation clause.

For the uniformly bounded-below family, use [thm-sp-truncation-e2]. Its second page is R^p f_* H^r. The schemes over affine opens of V are qcqs. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-cohomology-direct-sum] to H^r on those schemes, then [lem-weil-pbc-higher-direct-image-presheaf] and [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful] to identify the sheafified comparison with the higher-direct-image coproduct comparison. This identifies the second pages. Exact sums identify kernels and images, hence all later pages. In total degree q the lower bound a leaves only 0 <= p <= q-a, so the convergent filtrations are finite; induction on their short exact sequences identifies the abutments. For q<a both abutments vanish. Naturality identifies the resulting map with the stated Sigma.desc. Undo the truncation and glue the affine-local isomorphisms.

lean.statement: theorem derivedDirectImage_cohomology_coproduct {X Y : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] (I : Type u₁) (E : I → schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (S : schemeDerivedCategory X) (ι : ∀ i, (E i).obj ⟶ S) (hc : IsColimit (Cofan.mk S ι)) (q : ℤ) : IsIso (Sigma.desc (fun i ↦ (schemeHigherDirectImage f q).map (ι i)))
